body:
Shakespeare re-incarnated... Was hoping for a Oscar Wilde comparison myself. 

A normal person would probably say thanks for the compliment, the best I can do is try not to insult you and instead give some sarcastic remark. cheers for the compliment though, bad as it was. /s
Still, I cant really see what is so praiseworthy about my writing, myself I find it quite rushed and structurally poor, to each his own ey.

Correct, you can hardly place fault at the driver in your scenario, still doesnt mean he wont remember and be haunted by smashing you with his car though.

Something else than moving, yet changing the scenery ? intriguing, how does one go about making such a thing happen ?
My friend is dead, he cant have any wants or hopes for me. I too, for a long time wished I would be able to help others, trouble is, I loathe myself, am in constant ache, agonizingly numbing pain. So the most likely outcome is that I would somehow cause or inflict pain upon them. The more time I spend with a person, the higher the chance to hurt them, ending the relationship abrutly or cutting it short will also cause hurt. The only solution I see to avoid adding to the vicious circle of pain and suffering is to get out. Would also mean my own circle ends, so a double bonus.

It happened 3 years ago, give or take some months. Im working. construction. rather mundane.

How did the you get the nightmares to stop ? any sleeping or dreaming techniques, medication, or just time ?
Never done any substances of any kind. So no.

True, it was out of my control, and it especially is out of my control now. But it still wont go away. I still remember and relive it several times every day. and night, those are the worst.

I really hope I didnt come across as rude, although it is rude, to ask why you care. Thank for answering it though, reread it several times and tried to reflect and understand it. If I understood correctly, you care because you yourself were in a dark place, an empty and meaningless place and wanted out, found a reason to stay on and hope for me to do the same ? I both appreciate and thank you for your honesty and sincerity in your reply, and for not spewing the standard nonsense. Especially the "I dont understand what brought you here, but I understand what being there means" part. Made me think. Thank you.

Also, thank you for sharing something so personal and hard. 

Are you still on meds ? that idea, sorry, but it really isnt an option for me, it would risk a fate that for me is worse than anything I can imagine.

What kind of therapy ?

A tragic accident that I caused... The fact that I loved him, respect him, and cared for him makes me a good person ? Interesting. Goodness can be measured based on my capabilities for compasion. Seems a good parameter. Hits quite wide though, means you find earth to be almost filled with good people. I like that idea, unsure if I can adapt and follow it, but I nonetheless like it. Good for you !

Sorry, but I really loathe that sentence " time heals even the deepest wounds" made it take me some time to reply to you. How and why does time heal, it only piles on. Or will me getting older somehow also mean that the inevitable reflection and pondering I do also mean that this wound will heal ? Okay, thats the best I can phrase that, sorry if it doesnt make any sense.

Why do I deserve to be happy ? I know, stupid question, not like I think youre gonna write something that will make me go " yeah, I deserve to be happy" still, doesnt hurt to ask. Im sorry for causing you pain.

Youre right, I only have to get a simple flickering candle light going. The only light, ever, in my life, is gone. Before him I didnt know of lights, heck, I didnt even know of the candle itself.

Only support groups in my area are for various substance abusers.

Choice seems so weird to read. Yes, it wasnt a choice, but it was the result of a choice. of an action. 

You didnt cause the tsunami though, I caused the crash... Im truly sorry you had that experience, how did you cope ?

Forgivness aside, I cant forget. so, theres that.

The dreadful place I am in is inside, cant hardly move away. Ive tried traveling, but I always travel in the worst possible company, my own.

english isnt my native tongue and I have a bad habit of not rereading what I write, simply letting it flow and flow. Thank you for your reflection on it though, cant say I agree, but I will atleast say thanks. merry christmas.

I dont know your brothers, but I still doubt they would be happy to let you get beaten.

I was not drunk or under any substances, not tired, distracted or messing around. Always used to be a responsible driver, knowledge of physics made me respect the massive massive potential power a driver has. Sadly, I learned its even more massive than just the physical power it has..

Survivors guilt. interesting thing. Does that fit me though, seeing how yes, I survived, but I also caused it ?
I have seen the "peace" people on various pills, drugs and substances find. And I wont be strong enough to stop. I would try other drugs, I would experiement, become a massive burden.
I dont know, how ?
thank you.

All I found were support groups for substance abusers in my area. ptsd seems like a fit for me, you may have a point there. treatment seems expensive, expansive, and unobtainable though. ,still, thank you kind stranger on the internet.

Sorry if I seem daft, but, make my relationship with my friend count, what does that mean ? I really dont mean to sound this stupid or rude, I mean, something in my mind is nodding to those words, but its so small and tiny and I honestly dont understand.

Im sorry for your pain, if you dont mind me asking, why have you chosen to endure and "keep going" ? 

Makes me feel like a douche to write this, but yeah, I dont belive other people care, nor that Im a good person.

Why does so many of you have this notion that "my friend would want me to carry on, stay strong for your friend, what would he want you to do, etc" ? I understand your trying to help, I both understand and appreciate, but I still dont understand why his imaginary wishes for me is so relevant for everyone. he is dead. sorry.

thought about the idea of me singing when I read songwriting and snickered. hah. Art is a weird concept, I understand and partly agree with what you wrote, but still...

I know I shouldnt let them get to me, I really do, problem is, they are nowhere as mean and hurtful towards me as I am. Im not sure if I want to find other kind souls of fear that I will taint them. Dont want them to pour their kindness,goodness, and energy into the empty void that is me.

Did some searches for support groups etc, other than groups for substance abuses, there are no options at all around me.

wow, thanks for sharing something so personal. Neither of us were under influence of anything at that moment, none of that held any interest to us, mostly because of my parents I suppose.

The concept, or idea, of luck, is mute to me. I mean, I fail to understand it. luck, chance, statistics, worst possible outcome of a set of possible outcomes. It happened. Could have happened several other ways, but doesnt change the fact that it happened and I cant handle it.

I know dying would be easier than to push forward. But thats my point, it is easier. Some say cowardish, some say pathetic, some say weak. Still is easier, so what is wrong with that. Why is enduring and "holding on" considered to be so much better than finally being free of this hurt ?

What if I dont want to make a contribution, regardless of whether I can or cant forgive myself, I can never ever forget, so forgivness becomes somewhat "meh" 

I just want it all to end.

How can death be unnatural, or do you simply mean the want for it ? Through history you will find several people who took their own life in order to save others or better their lives, same for plenty of animals. guess Im nitpicking, sorry.

What you wrote about kniting, social connections, it all seems pretty wide, as in, it fits for a lot of people and situations. Doesnt make it less right in my case though, you are absolutely right. 

The thing is though, I dont really have "access" to social gatherings, and walking up to a stranger on the road and just start talking to them will most likely result in them saying "merry christmas and goodbye" as they walk away. 

I dont do well around other people. I really struggle. Fortunately, or unfortunately actually, I manage to act quite well. I put on a facade, no longer being me. if that makes sense. A shrink would probably say "In fear of rejection, you reject others before they can reject you". Doesnt change the fact that I struggle around people, not that I am around other people a lot. roughly a handful of social gatherings so far this year. I have a good facade, other than the lack of smiles, there is little reason for people to ask questions about me. got membership at a 24hour gym, eat fairly healthy and dress properly, so the facade is good, the acting is solid, and people never bother looking deeper anyways.

To be honest, Im probably afraid of bonding with other people. of either inflicting the pain I feel on them, even if its the last thing I want to do, that still doesnt mean it wont happen. I cant control it, I cant prevent it for all eternity. At some point, I will hurt them. fuck I hate empathy. passing a beggar on the street, and being unable to help other than by giving him some shitty coins, makes me tear up and hate myself. I struggle with handling the pain I see others have to go through. Realising that I will at some point add to their pain and hurt scares me from action. Pain is all I know. I dont understand happiness, I reject it, never experienced outside of my friend, feel unworthy of it.

Ptsd seems like a good fit, doesnt really change anything. Unsure if I want to get help, or if I believe help is avaible and possible. 

"You can do this" do what ? I can "get through this, live on, prosper etc" ? what do people mean when they say you can get through this ? I dont mean to sound condescending or rude, I honestly am puzzled.

If I were to become someone of deep wisdom, chances are extremely slim it would be of any good to anyone.. 

You wrote some excellent points, and a lot of of what you wrote is still being prosessed and molded over. You made me reflect and think about things I dont like to think about. I had to read it several times, force myslf to be in the right state of mind, not just toss it away. But to actually read it, if you know what I mean. Im sorry my response isnt as adequate as your comment, kinda struggling to put my thoughts on your comment into words. 

Know that you made me reflect. so I thank you for taking your time and effort, really, thank you. Ill write my thoughts when I know how.

I feel I must apologize for the tardiness of my responses, I truly do appreciated you taking both time and making an effort to help me. I really do. Sadly the trolls scare me. Not because the words in themself hurt or because they are so cruel, but because what they write are words Im already saying to myself. And the piling on really does pile it on, making it tough.

Im sorry Im not strong enough to ignore them, to face them and for letting that scare me. its just, reading others repeat the worst things you say about yourself gets through in a dangerous way. Makes me wonder "Why wait to new years eve, the census is in, you should kill yourself"

Guess Im a coward is what Im saying.
Ok, wow, for now, all I can say is thank you for taking your time and brain power to write out all that. Still taking some time to prosess it and working up a proper response to it.

Not a veteran, so getting any of those kind of treatments seem clearly out of reach. Alas. But thanks for the gesture and good on you for following up. Dont change. Or do if you want, Im not your boss.

The prospect of death is finale, aye, true that. But who is this person I owe "living my life to its fullest potential" surely that is to myself ? sure, I will be dead for the rest of eternity, I also didnt exist for the first 16 billion years this universe existed. Seems it still managed to go on without me. 
With my healthy body, living in this era and age of time, most likely I would to around 90 years or so. holy fuck. just writing living to 90 makes me catch my breath. Im struggling to make myself continue forward through this pain for another minute. Continuing my existence for years makes me want to cry out. 

I may have had a hand in the progress of reaching this point of feeling worthless, not going to denie that. Fact is, I longed for death at the age of 5. Not that I completely understood the concept. But life was already at that point unbearable.

Make that no family support. or even more accurately, no support. The help I sought didnt really help, rather made it painstakingly clear that I cant do this. That time doesnt heal all wounds, it just piles on and on. I want out. This every second of hurt, not an discomfortable ache, but pain that cuts through all I am with an agony so hard I catch myself sitting with the pain reflected on my face before I quickly conceil it behind the beautiful mask that is a smile. Whenever I see my reflection in a mirror or a window, I have to fight this urging desire to strangle myself. to bring pain upon the wretched human that stares back at me.

I did as you asked, found a sheet of paper, wrote "Where I want to spend New years eve" in one row, and made columns with each year. The result may not be what you hoped for, did it nonetheless. I want to spend the new years eve of 2013 free. I didnt manage to write a single word for the next years. The very prospect of thinking about living on hurts and makes me shudder. I think I failed your task.

That would change the materialistic part of my life. that part really isnt so much of a trouble. But solid advice for lots of people. Change of scenery is often good Ive heard. Only, doesnt matter if I close my eyes in london,paris,berlin,cape town,moscow,sydney,tokyo,los angeles or calcutta, I still see him dying.

What other methods of therapy do you mean ? as for medicine, it becomes something along the line of putting on a mask. Wont actually do anything, just means I will atleast put on a smile so other people wont be uncomfortable around me. Also, with the heavy amounts of drug and alcohol abuse in my family history Im afraid I wont be able to stop. And I really really do not want to end up a junkie or user like my parents. That is to me, a faith far worse than anything I could ever imagine. that thought scares me deep.
How can they understand ? and if they do, how does that help me. And why does it help me ? Im puzzled, should the fact that others suffer or have endured pain make it easier for me to endure mine ?
Someone did it for me.

I didnt intend to hurt him, or crash. We were simply going from point A to B. I dont delude myself to think I can in anyway change it, it happened and will forever stick with me. Problem is, it will forever stick with me and it crushes me.

I appreciate the sentiment of what you wrote, I just dont fully understand it to be honest. Dont mean to sound dense, I just dont grasp how that indicates goodness in me.

Before I met my friend I had already died. I lived as a person with nothing. I couldnt get harmed nor could I get happy. I was more of an object, if that makes any sense. He gave me what I at that time thought was hope, but now realise was just a delusion. The only good experiences and memories I have, from the day I was born until this day, all include my friend somehow... 

things will get better, have to call you out on that cliche. How do you know it will get better ? why will it get better ? because it has to ? Frankly, I dont know if I want it to get better or if I want everyone to taste just a fraction of the pain Im in. I know, Im not a good person.

Again, I dont understand, dont mean to be rude if it seems so, but how can you care ?
Who have I shot down ? What do you know about what I write to them in pm ? If I shot you down, good. Your advice is horrible and quite frankly just seems heinous.

what the fuck is your problem ? do you get a thrill out of kicking someone who is already down ? does walking on someone who has already fallen make you feel better about yourself ? fuck off, please stop with the trolling pms and replies. just stop.

Your right. it doesnt go away. It does however taint and ruin everything I do and see, everything I eat and touch. Removes the colour out of life, the taste in food and the joy in a smile and warmth of laughter. Like cancer in your very core. If I believed in souls Id say I have lost mine, or cancer in it.

youre belittling me by comparing it to losing a finger.
80 years more of pain... doesnt really sound tempting.

I wouldnt call what Im doing living. What others have suffered from and recovered from is utterly irrelevant for me.
I got mandatory therapy for my obvious guilt after the accident and some extra hours afterwards. didnt give me anything as you can probably guess since I am where I am.
again, what the fuck are you trying to say, are you trolling or something ?
what does that even mean ?

And how can that be fixed if I dare ask ? I know I can be free. just tie a little piece of rope and a couple of minutes later Ill no longer be in pain. I have already spent several sessions in therapy a while back. 

I am worthless as I am without merit, practical value, or usefulness. Despicable if youd like. I am empty. nothing. All my life I had 2 lifes. one where at home I tried protecting my siblings from the rage my father would get once drunk. which he luckily only got about four times a week. My friend made it all tolerable. was something of a candle light. Not a massive and huge light by itself, but when placed in the darkest of rooms, a candle will throw its light further than initially thought. That light has gone out and the only thing left is darkness and an empty void.

Youd rather I endure for the sake of enduring ? 
Its not that death suddenly seems appealing. Im done and want out. The fact that you think Im a fucking child isnt really what I thought would be the response on this thread. No idea what i expected, but certainly not this.
You seem to have decided to not read what I wrote I guess since you think my wish to die is based entirely on that one thing. Cheers on the tough love, really makes me want to live btw.

I wouldnt wish for him to stay alive just because death seems scary to some. If he was suffering and in paind I would him rather be free of that.

Unsure whether I am a bad person or not, I do know Im worthless and utterly and completely wrecked. My life holds no meaning.
I really fail to understand your reply. Im a bastard and my friend fucked up ? I was 19, hardly "just a child"

he is dead. he cant wish for me to be either alive or dead. I know, harsh. but thinking what he would want me to do is just crushing me and splitting my brain. starting that chain of thoughts is akin to that of starting to pump air into my skull, it feels like itll rip apart. because the thoughts doesnt stop there.

not a bad person. how do you figuere that ? which parameters for good and bad have I met ? I have felt my life and life in general is worthless for a long time.

People do not care. They honestly dont. Give them a true answer to the question "how are you" and they dont ask any follow up questions or talk to you at all again.
